# Wiberg Metal — llms.txt

> For extended product details, specifications, and technical data, see: https://wibergmetal.com/llms-full.txt

> Wiberg Metal is a China-based steel grating manufacturer specializing in industrial platforms, walkways, stair systems, trench covers, and FRP grating. We supply to international projects in oil & gas, power generation, petrochemical, data centers, water treatment, marine, and infrastructure sectors.

## Company overview

- Website: https://wibergmetal.com
- Email: info@wibergmetal.com
- WhatsApp: +86 132 7317 7087
- Location: Shanghai, China
- Experience: 18+ years
- Facility: 20,000 m² production, 4 production lines, robotic welding
- Capacity: 300,000 m²/year
- Standards: GB (YB/T 4001), ANSI/NAAMM MBG 531, EN ISO 24637, ASTM A1 053, BS EN 1090
- Export markets: Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, South America, Europe, Oceania

## Products

### Bar Grating
- [Welded Bar Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/welded-bar-grating/): Press-welded (forge-welded) at every crossing. Most common type. Models: G305/30/100, G325/30/100, 19-W-4.
- [Press-Locked Bar Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/press-locked-bar-grating/): Mechanical interlock, no weld marks. Architectural and flush-surface applications.
- [Heavy-Duty Welded Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/heavy-duty-welded-bar-grating/): Thicker bearing bars (40–65 mm) for high point loads and heavy equipment.
- [Serrated Bar Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/serrated-bar-grating/): Anti-slip serrated bearing bar surface for wet/oily environments.
- [Close-Mesh Bar Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/close-mesh-bar-grating/): Narrow openings to prevent small objects falling through. High-heel safe.
- [Composite Steel Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/composite-steel-grating/): Checker plate bonded to bar grating. Full coverage surface.
- [Ball-Proof Grating](https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/ball-proof-grating/): Mesh openings small enough to prevent a 35 mm sphere from passing.

### Stair Treads

## How to get a quote
Send project details (drawings, dimensions, load requirements, finish, quantity) to info@wibergmetal.com or use https://wibergmetal.com/rfq/. Typical response within 24 business hours.
